// MattSkills 面板(Panel,即 Surface 页签加载的 Web 文档)文案表(工单 09):全部界面中文

// 多语言词表即可,渲染点不动。纯脚本无 import,build 时拼进 bundle-0.txt(段序第一),
// Node 测试直接 import 执行同一 IIFE。

// (M1 仅 zh,静态自检见 test/scaffold.test.mjs 文案段)。

    "panel.empty.mid": " 初始化,或让 agent 用 ",
    "panel.empty.tickets": "/to-tickets",
    "panel.empty.end": " 拆解规格。",
    "panel.empty.hint": "生成工单后,本页签会展示任务看板。",
    "panel.boardTitle": "任务看板",

    // ---- 计数胶囊条(nav.takeable/occupied/bug/triage 键名同上游 panel.yaml,M1 补齐其余) ----
    "nav.takeable": "可接",

// MattSkills 像素卡域(工单 04):PixelCards 色表/档位/对比度罩纱与容器三态的移植,纯函数。
// 真源:port-notes/pixel-cards.md(上游 PixelCardTheme.ts / PixelCardBtns.ts)与
// port-notes/kernel-domain.md(上游 container-view.ts)、action-prompts.md(上游 row-actions.ts)。
// 双态加载:build 时原样拼进 bundle-0.txt(纯脚本,IIFE 挂 globalThis);Node 测试直接 import
// 执行同一 IIFE。无 DOM 依赖——渲染在 app.js,这里只出数据与判定。
"use strict";
(function (global) {
  // 动作色表(pixel-cards.md §1):hex 一律无 # 前缀;map 是 cardColorOf 的兜底色。
  var CARD_ACTION_COLORS = {
    diagnose: "fbca04",
    fix: "d73a4a",
    execute: "10b981",
    claim: "b60205",
    supplement: "5319e7",
    research: "0ea5e9",
    grill: "9d7cd8",
    proto: "f59e0b",
    map: "8b5cf6",
    block: "a3231a",
  };

  // 档位样式(pixel-cards.md §2):colorKey 先查页面标签色表;colorKey 都 miss 才落动作色表。
  // hollow=false 实心编号徽章(底=主色,字=cardInkOn);true 描线款(边=主色,墨字)。
  // icon 是 PixelCardBtns 的 ICB 内联 SVG 名(chat/play/search/hammer/proto),M1 行内不画按钮,留档对齐。
  var CARD_ACTION_STYLE = {
    diagnose: { colorKey: "needs-triage", icon: "chat", hollow: false },
    fix: { colorKey: "bug", icon: "hammer", hollow: false },
    execute: { colorKey: "wayfinder:task", icon: "play", hollow: false },
    claim: { colorKey: "ready-for-human", icon: "play", hollow: false },
    supplement: { colorKey: "needs-info", icon: "play", hollow: false },
    research: { colorKey: "wayfinder:research", icon: "search", hollow: true },
    grill: { colorKey: "wayfinder:grilling", icon: "chat", hollow: true },
    proto: { colorKey: "wayfinder:prototype", icon: "proto", hollow: true },
    implement: { colorKey: "implement", icon: "hammer", hollow: false },
  };

  // 容器身份色(kernel-domain.md §6,上游 container-view.ts 唯一真源)。
  var CONTAINER_ACCENT = { map: "#c084fc", spec: "#1D4ED8" };
  var CONTAINER_TINT = { map: "rgba(188,140,255,.07)", spec: "rgba(29,78,216,.10)" };
  var CONTAINER_CHIP_CLASS = { map: "dsws-chip-m", spec: "dsws-chip-s" };
  var CONTAINER_CHIP_LABEL = { map: "地图", spec: "规格" }; // 上游 list.mapChip / list.specChip
  var CONTAINER_EMPTY_COLOR = "#f59e0b";
  var CONTAINER_DONE_COLOR = "#3fb950";

  // ---- 对比度罩纱(PixelCardTheme.ts):#1c1004 深墨与 #fff9ec 米白二选一,双阈值标记浅色罩纱带 ----
  function lumChan(x) {
    x /= 255;
    return x <= 0.03928 ? x / 12.92 : Math.pow((x + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4);
  }
  function cardLum(hex) {
    var h = String(hex === null || hex === undefined ? "" : hex).replace(/^#/, "");
    if (!/^[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(h)) return 0;
    return (
      0.2126 * lumChan(parseInt(h.slice(0, 2), 16)) +
      0.7152 * lumChan(parseInt(h.slice(2, 4), 16)) +
      0.0722 * lumChan(parseInt(h.slice(4, 6), 16))
    );
  }
  function cardInkOn(hex) {
    var l = cardLum(hex);
    return (l + 0.05) / 0.05 >= 1.05 / (l + 0.05) ? "#1c1004" : "#fff9ec";
  }
  function cardBoostOn(hex) {
    var l = cardLum(hex);
    var wOk = 1.05 / (l + 0.05) >= 4.6; // 白字达标(留 4.6 余量而非 4.5)
    var dOk = (l + 0.05) / (cardLum("1c1004") + 0.05) >= 4.5; // 深字达标
    return !wOk && !dOk; // 两种字都不达标 → 浅色主题加深墨罩纱(元素标 data-cd-boost="1")
  }

  /** 主色:先查页面标签色表(colorOf),miss 落档位兜底色,再 miss 回地图紫;去 # 转小写。 */
  function cardColorOf(colorKey, colorOf, actionKey) {
    var c = colorOf && colorOf[colorKey];
    if (!c && actionKey) c = CARD_ACTION_COLORS[actionKey];
    return String(c === null || c === undefined ? "" : c).replace(/^#/, "").toLowerCase() || "8b5cf6";
  }

  // ---- 档位判定(action-prompts.md rowActionKind 十档阶梯:状态优先于类型,标签按 name) ----
  function labelSet(row) {
    var out = {};
    var ls = row && Array.isArray(row.labels) ? row.labels : [];
    for (var i = 0; i < ls.length; i++) {
      if (ls[i] && ls[i].name) out[String(ls[i].name)] = true;
    }
    return out;
  }
  function rowActionKind(row) {
    var has = labelSet(row);
    var n = 0;
    for (var k in has) n++;
    if (n === 0 || has["needs-triage"]) return "diagnose"; // 无标签或 needs-triage → 诊断
    if (has["ready-for-human"]) return "claim"; // 接手优先于修复(两枚同现取接手)
    if (has["needs-info"]) return "supplement";
    if (has.bug) return "fix";
    if (has["wayfinder:grilling"]) return "grill";
    if (has["wayfinder:research"]) return "research";
    if (has["wayfinder:prototype"]) return "proto";
    if (has["wayfinder:task"]) return "execute";
    if (has["ready-for-agent"]) return "implement";
    return "execute"; // 兜底执行
  }

  // ---- 容器三态(kernel-domain.md §6):stats 缺失或 total=0 → empty;closed===total → done ----
  function containerStateOf(stats) {
    var total = stats && typeof stats.total === "number" ? stats.total : 0;
    var closed = stats && typeof stats.closed === "number" ? stats.closed : 0;
    if (total <= 0) return "empty";
    if (closed >= total) return "done";
    return "open";
  }
  /** 容器编号徽章色:done→绿 / empty→橙 / open:spec 贵族蓝、map 走 map 紫。 */
  function containerNumberColor(kind, state) {
    if (state === "done") return CONTAINER_DONE_COLOR;
    if (state === "empty") return CONTAINER_EMPTY_COLOR;
    return kind === "spec" ? CONTAINER_ACCENT.spec : "#" + CARD_ACTION_COLORS.map;
  }

  // ---- 视图投影(工单 04):状态分桶/占用口径/标签 OR/三段排序/标签目录与点击记忆 ----
  function openBlockerCountOf(row) {
    if (!Array.isArray(row.blockedBy)) return 0;
    var n = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < row.blockedBy.length; i++) {
      var r = row.blockedBy[i];
      if (!r || r.state !== "closed") n++; // 断链(无目标)按安全阻塞计
    }
    return n;
  }
  /** 占用口径(list-page.md:blocked 筛选 = isOccupied):open 且(有认领人 或 被 open 阻塞)。 */
  function isOccupiedRow(row) {
    if (row.state === "closed") return false;
    if (Array.isArray(row.assignees) && row.assignees.length > 0) return true;
    return openBlockerCountOf(row) > 0;
  }
  /** 标签 OR 过滤:命中任一选中标签即显示;无标签行只在选了 needs-triage 时显示。容器行由调用方豁免。 */
  function labelMatches(row, labels) {
    if (!labels || labels.length === 0) return true;
    var names = [];
    var ls = Array.isArray(row.labels) ? row.labels : [];
    for (var i = 0; i < ls.length; i++) if (ls[i] && ls[i].name) names.push(String(ls[i].name));
    for (var j = 0; j < labels.length; j++) {
      if (names.indexOf(labels[j]) >= 0) return true;
      if (labels[j] === "needs-triage" && names.length === 0) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  /**
   * 状态视图投影:list-page.md 口径。
   *   all/open → openRows(容器行 + open 票,容器不受标签筛),closed 票进 closedRows;
   *   blocked  → openRows = 占用票(容器不进);frontier → 非占用票;
   *   closed   → 只给 closedRows,openRows 恒空。
   */
  function applyView(rows, sel) {
    var labels = (sel && sel.labels) || [];
    var state = (sel && sel.state) || "all";
    var openRows = [];
    var closedRows = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      var row = rows[i];
      var isContainer = row.type === "map" || row.type === "spec";
      if (state === "closed") {
        if (!isContainer && row.state === "closed" && labelMatches(row, labels)) closedRows.push(row);
        continue;
      }
      if (isContainer) {
        if (state === "all" || state === "open") openRows.push(row); // 容器行不受标签筛
        continue;
      }
      if (row.state === "closed") {
        if (labelMatches(row, labels)) closedRows.push(row);
        continue;
      }
      if (state === "blocked" && !isOccupiedRow(row)) continue;
      if (state === "frontier" && isOccupiedRow(row)) continue;
      if (!labelMatches(row, labels)) continue;
      openRows.push(row);
    }
    return { openRows: openRows, closedRows: closedRows };
  }

  function rowKeyNumOf(row) {
    var m = /(\d+)\s*$/.exec(String(row.key || ""));
    return m ? parseInt(m[1], 10) : 0;
  }
  /** 三段排序:容器段序固定(map→spec,组间不比较键),组内按 sortKey × dir;同键兜底 effort → 编号升序。 */
  function sortViewRows(rows, sortKey, dir) {
    var d = dir === -1 ? -1 : 1;
    var rank = { map: 0, spec: 1 };
    var cmp = function (a, b) {
      var va;
      var vb;
      if (sortKey === "title") {
        va = String(a.title || "").toLowerCase();
        vb = String(b.title || "").toLowerCase();
        if (va !== vb) return va.localeCompare(vb) * d;
      } else if (sortKey === "updatedAt" || sortKey === "createdAt") {
        va = String(a[sortKey] || "");
        vb = String(b[sortKey] || "");
        if (va !== vb) return (va < vb ? -1 : 1) * d; // ISO 串字典序即时间序
      } else {
        va = rowKeyNumOf(a);
        vb = rowKeyNumOf(b);
        if (va !== vb) return (va - vb) * d;
      }
      var e = String(a.effortId || "").localeCompare(String(b.effortId || ""));
      if (e) return e;
      return rowKeyNumOf(a) - rowKeyNumOf(b);
    };
    return rows.slice().sort(function (a, b) {
      var ka = rank[a.type] ?? 2;
      var kb = rank[b.type] ?? 2;
      if (ka !== kb) return ka - kb;
      return cmp(a, b);
    });
  }

  /** 标签目录:全量行(含 closed)的标签频次表(Map name→count)。 */
  function labelCatalog(rows) {
    var cat = new Map();
    for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      var ls = Array.isArray(rows[i].labels) ? rows[i].labels : [];
      for (var j = 0; j < ls.length; j++) {
        if (!ls[j] || !ls[j].name) continue;
        var n = String(ls[j].name);
        cat.set(n, (cat.get(n) || 0) + 1);
      }
    }
    return cat;
  }
  /** 标签 chips 排序(list-page.md 点击记忆四键):次数降序 → 最近点击降序 → 频次降序 → 名称序。 */
  function sortLabelChips(cat, clicks) {
    var entries = [];
    cat.forEach(function (count, name) {
      entries.push({ name: name, count: count });
    });
    var c = clicks || {};
    return entries.sort(function (a, b) {
      var an = (c[a.name] && c[a.name].n) || 0;
      var bn = (c[b.name] && c[b.name].n) || 0;
      if (an !== bn) return bn - an;
      var at = (c[a.name] && c[a.name].ts) || 0;
      var bt = (c[b.name] && c[b.name].ts) || 0;
      if (at !== bt) return bt - at;
      if (a.count !== b.count) return b.count - a.count;
      return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
    });
  }

  // ---- 墨块色值小工具(list-page.md chips):hex → alpha 底 / darken 边 ----
  function hexA(hex, a) {
    var h = String(hex === null || hex === undefined ? "" : hex).replace(/^#/, "");
    if (!/^[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(h)) return "rgba(188,140,255," + a + ")";
    return (
      "rgba(" + parseInt(h.slice(0, 2), 16) + "," + parseInt(h.slice(2, 4), 16) + "," +
      parseInt(h.slice(4, 6), 16) + "," + a + ")"
    );
  }
  function darkenHex(hex, amt) {
    var h = String(hex === null || hex === undefined ? "" : hex).replace(/^#/, "");
    if (!/^[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(h)) return "#bc8cff";
    var out = "#";
    for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      var v = Math.round(parseInt(h.slice(i * 2, i * 2 + 2), 16) * (1 - amt));
      out += (v < 16 ? "0" : "") + v.toString(16);
    }
    return out;
  }

  global.MattSkillsCards = Object.freeze({
    CARD_ACTION_COLORS: CARD_ACTION_COLORS,
    CARD_ACTION_STYLE: CARD_ACTION_STYLE,
    CONTAINER_ACCENT: CONTAINER_ACCENT,
    CONTAINER_TINT: CONTAINER_TINT,
    CONTAINER_CHIP_CLASS: CONTAINER_CHIP_CLASS,
    CONTAINER_CHIP_LABEL: CONTAINER_CHIP_LABEL,
    CONTAINER_EMPTY_COLOR: CONTAINER_EMPTY_COLOR,
    CONTAINER_DONE_COLOR: CONTAINER_DONE_COLOR,
    cardLum: cardLum,
    cardInkOn: cardInkOn,
    cardBoostOn: cardBoostOn,
    cardColorOf: cardColorOf,
    rowActionKind: rowActionKind,
    containerStateOf: containerStateOf,
    containerNumberColor: containerNumberColor,
    applyView: applyView,
    sortViewRows: sortViewRows,
    labelCatalog: labelCatalog,
    sortLabelChips: sortLabelChips,
    isOccupiedRow: isOccupiedRow,
    openBlockerCountOf: openBlockerCountOf,
    hexA: hexA,
    darkenHex: darkenHex,
  });
})(typeof globalThis !== "undefined" ? globalThis : undefined);

// MattSkills 动作域(工单 07):详情页动作栏的 prompt 生成与门控,纯函数。
// 真源:port-notes/action-prompts.md(九模板 zh 全文、{{shared:*}} 五节原文(sharedTools
// 两句 M1 裁剪,见下)、十级判定表)与 detail-page.md §4(detailTopGate:未知状态不置灰)。
// 裁剪口径(与工单验收一致,取舍见工单报告):
//   - 保留十级阶梯产出的九档动作模板(diagnose/fix/implement/takeover/supplement/
//     discuss/execute/research/prototype;discuss/execute/research 三档同文 mapTicketAdvance);
//   - 裁掉 handoff1/handoff2:它们不是行档位动作,{path}(上一会话交接文档路径)面板无法提供;
//   - 裁掉容器注入键(specSplit/specExecute/specComplete/mapInspect):容器三态动作条不在本票。
// 双态加载:build 时原样拼进 bundle-0.txt(纯脚本,IIFE 挂 globalThis);Node 测试直接 import
// 执行同一 IIFE。无 DOM 依赖——渲染在 detail.mjs。
"use strict";
(function (global) {
  // ---- 档位文案(card.act.* 九档;工单 09 起值单处集中在 copy.mjs,bundle 段序在其后) ----
  var ACTION_LABELS = {};
  (function () {
    var copy = globalThis.MattSkillsCopy || {};
    var kinds = ["diagnose", "fix", "execute", "claim", "supplement", "research", "grill", "proto", "implement"];
    for (var i = 0; i < kinds.length; i++) ACTION_LABELS[kinds[i]] = copy["card.act." + kinds[i]] || kinds[i];
  })();

  // ---- 公共小节(shared-sections.yaml zh 全文;mapTicketAdvance = Opening + WrapUp 拼接) ----
  // M1 裁剪:sharedTools 两句点名 deck_issue_report / suggest_next_steps,这两个工具不在
  // M1 工具面,改成不点工具名的诚实表述(其余逐字不动);上游原文见 port-notes/action-prompts.md。
  var SHARED_SECTIONS = {
    firstPrinciples: "从第一性原理出发。",
    sharedTools: [

      "- [ ] 答案在当前维护者手上就当场问；在报告人或外部人手上，把问题写成一条票内评论（带上面的声明），并写明等谁回。",

    discuss: "{{shared:mapTicketAdvance}}",

    prototype: [

      "- [ ] 写清什么算数：已点头的界面、状态与交互逐条列出；没被选中的备选明确写成不算数。下游只照列出的部分做。",
      "- [ ] 写下照做标准与复核人：实施时对照哪几个界面或状态、什么算还原；由当初点头这一版的人复核。这是给下游写规格与实施票的移交要求，不是本票要交的验收证据。",

  };

  // 阶梯档位(cards.mjs rowActionKind 的产出)→ 模板键:三处命名不同,其余同名。
  var LADDER_TO_TEMPLATE = { claim: "takeover", grill: "discuss", proto: "prototype" };

  // ---- {{shared:*}} 展开:逐层递归;未知小节、成环都报错(真源必须完整) ----
  var SHARED_RE = /\{\{shared:([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)\}\}/;
  function expandTemplate(tpl, shared, stack) {
    var table = shared || SHARED_SECTIONS;
    var seen = stack || [];
    return String(tpl === null || tpl === undefined ? "" : tpl).replace(new RegExp(SHARED_RE.source, "g"), function (_, name) {
      if (seen.indexOf(name) >= 0) throw Error("公共小节成环: " + seen.concat(name).join(" → "));
      if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(table, name)) throw Error("未知公共小节: " + name);
      return expandTemplate(table[name], table, seen.concat(name));
    });
  }

  // ---- 占位符替换:ctx 里有值的 {name} 逐一替换;无值保留原样(便于发现缺上下文) ----
  function fillPlaceholders(text, ctx) {
    return String(text).replace(/\{([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\}/g, function (whole, name) {
      var v = ctx ? ctx[name] : undefined;
      return v === undefined || v === null ? whole : String(v);
    });
  }

  /** 档位 → 完整 prompt:模板 → shared 展开 → 占位替换。未知档位是接线 bug,报错。 */
  function buildActionPrompt(kind, ctx) {
    var tplKey = LADDER_TO_TEMPLATE[kind] || kind;
    if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(ACTION_TEMPLATES, tplKey)) throw Error("未知档位: " + kind);
    return fillPlaceholders(expandTemplate(ACTION_TEMPLATES[tplKey]), ctx || {});
  }

  // ---- 详情动作门控(detail-page.md §4,上游 detail-top-gate.ts 口径) ----
  /** 阻塞票「明确还没做完」:无合并时间,且状态归一后恰好是 open;缺失/认不出按未知,不置灰。 */
  function explicitlyUnfinished(node) {
    if (!node || typeof node !== "object") return false;
    if (node.mergedAt) return false; // 合并时间是已完成的硬证据
    var state = node.state === null || node.state === undefined ? "" : String(node.state).trim().toLowerCase();
    return state === "open";
  }
  /** 阻塞票号:只认可用正整数(M1 行无 number 字段,从 key 尾数字取),其余当未知。 */
  function usableNumber(node) {
    var m = /(\d+)\s*$/.exec(String((node && node.key) || ""));
    var n = m ? parseInt(m[1], 10) : NaN;
    return Number.isInteger(n) && n > 0 ? n : null;
  }
  /**
   * 动作按钮能不能点:票关闭 → closed;被「明确 open」的票阻塞 → blocked(号去重升序);
   * 其余(含阻塞票数据不全的未知态)一律可点——凭猜置灰等于替用户否掉一张可能能开工的票。
   */
  function detailTopGateOf(row) {
    if (row && row.state !== "open") return { clickable: false, reason: "closed", blockedNumbers: [] };
    var list = row && Array.isArray(row.blockedBy) ? row.blockedBy : [];
    var numbers = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
      if (!explicitlyUnfinished(list[i])) continue;
      var n = usableNumber(list[i]);
      if (n === null) continue;
      if (numbers.indexOf(n) < 0) numbers.push(n);
    }
    numbers.sort(function (a, b) { return a - b; });
    if (numbers.length) return { clickable: false, reason: "blocked", blockedNumbers: numbers };
    return { clickable: true, reason: "none", blockedNumbers: [] };
  }

  // ---- 图标(PixelCardBtns.ts 的 ICB 内联 SVG,结构化直拷;viewBox 0 0 24 24,12×12 渲染) ----
  var ACTION_ICONS = {
    chat: [
      { tag: "path", attrs: { d: "M21 15a2 2 0 01-2 2H8l-5 4V5a2 2 0 012-2h14a2 2 0 012 2z", fill: "none", stroke: "currentColor", "stroke-width": "1.8", "stroke-linecap": "round", "stroke-linejoin": "round" } },
    ],
    play: [
      { tag: "path", attrs: { d: "M8 5.5l11 6.5-11 6.5z", fill: "currentColor", stroke: "none" } },
    ],
    search: [
      { tag: "circle", attrs: { cx: "11", cy: "11", r: "7", fill: "none", stroke: "currentColor", "stroke-width": "1.8" } },
      { tag: "path", attrs: { d: "M21 21l-4.3-4.3", stroke: "currentColor", "stroke-width": "1.8", "stroke-linecap": "round" } },
    ],
    hammer: [
      { tag: "path", attrs: { d: "M14 4l6 6-2.5 2.5-6-6z", fill: "none", stroke: "currentColor", "stroke-width": "1.8" } },
      { tag: "path", attrs: { d: "M3 21l7.5-7.5", stroke: "currentColor", "stroke-width": "1.8", "stroke-linecap": "round" } },
      { tag: "path", attrs: { d: "M12.5 9.5l2 2", stroke: "currentColor", "stroke-width": "1.8", "stroke-linecap": "round" } },
    ],
    proto: [
      { tag: "rect", attrs: { x: "3", y: "8.5", width: "13", height: "9", rx: "2", opacity: "0.52", fill: "none", stroke: "currentColor", "stroke-width": "1.8" } },
      { tag: "rect", attrs: { x: "7.8", y: "3.8", width: "13", height: "9", rx: "2", fill: "none", stroke: "currentColor", "stroke-width": "1.8" } },
    ],
  };

  global.MattSkillsActions = Object.freeze({
    ACTION_LABELS: ACTION_LABELS,
    ACTION_TEMPLATES: ACTION_TEMPLATES,
    SHARED_SECTIONS: SHARED_SECTIONS,
    ACTION_ICONS: ACTION_ICONS,
    expandTemplate: expandTemplate,
    fillPlaceholders: fillPlaceholders,
    buildActionPrompt: buildActionPrompt,
    detailTopGateOf: detailTopGateOf,
  });
})(typeof globalThis !== "undefined" ? globalThis : undefined);

// MattSkills 面板应用(bundle-0.txt 的源):列表 tracer 的渲染与桥调用。
// 纯脚本无 import(资源通道只搬文本,拼接后以 <script> 注入执行),经 window.MattSkillsPanel.boot
// 交给引导页/测试架驱动。对宿主只有两个依赖:client(ext-apps 桥)与 doc(DOM)。
// 类名命名空间 ms-(M1 基础卡面;完整 PixelCards 色卡体系是工单 04,届时换 cd- 体系)。
"use strict";
(function () {
  // ---- 文案(工单 09 收拢):全部界面中文单处集中在 copy.mjs(bundle 段序第一),
  // 键名按上游 copy 词表组织,为 M3 i18n 配置化留缝;本段只按键取值。 ----
  var COPY = globalThis.MattSkillsCopy;

  // 九条计数口径:顺序即胶囊条从左到右;前三枚带 KPI 色值(list-page.md KPI 行:
  // 可接 #4ade80 / 占用 #f0883e / 已关闭 #52525b)。label 是 copy 键(nav.* 家族)。
  var PILLS = [
    { key: "frontier", label: "nav.takeable", color: "#4ade80" },
    { key: "open", label: "nav.open" },
    { key: "occupied", label: "nav.occupied", color: "#f0883e" },
    { key: "claimed", label: "nav.claimed" },
    { key: "blocked", label: "nav.blocked" },
    { key: "bug", label: "nav.bug" },
    { key: "triage", label: "nav.triage" },
    { key: "closed", label: "nav.closed", color: "#52525b" },
    { key: "total", label: "nav.total" },
  ];

  // 内置默认标签色表(上游 src/tracker/rooms/markdown/index.ts defaultLabelPalette 的直拷,
  // 全仓唯一出处;票面既不在色表也没有自带色时回灰 cccccc)。
  var LABEL_COLORS = {
    "bug": "d73a4a",
    "needs-triage": "fbca04",
    "needs-info": "5319e7",
    "ready-for-agent": "0e8a16",
    "ready-for-human": "b60205",
    "wontfix": "ffffff",
    "wayfinder:map": "8b5cf6",
    "wayfinder:research": "0ea5e9",
    "wayfinder:prototype": "f59e0b",
    "wayfinder:grilling": "9d7cd8",
    "wayfinder:task": "10b981",
  };
  function labelColorOf(name) {
    return LABEL_COLORS[name] || "cccccc";
  }

  // PixelCards 域(工单 04,src/ui/cards.mjs;拼接进 bundle 后挂 globalThis)。
  var Cards = globalThis.MattSkillsCards || {};
  // 页面 colorOf 表:标签配置色 + implement 档塞规格身份色(pixel-cards.md §1)。
  var COLOR_OF = Object.assign({}, LABEL_COLORS, { implement: Cards.CONTAINER_ACCENT ? Cards.CONTAINER_ACCENT.spec.slice(1) : "1D4ED8" });

  // ---- 小工具 ----
  function el(doc, tag, cls, text) {
    var n = doc.createElement(tag);
    if (cls) n.className = cls;
    if (text !== undefined && text !== null) n.textContent = String(text);
    return n;
  }
  function textOf(res) {
    if (res && Array.isArray(res.content)) {
      for (var c of res.content) if (c && c.type === "text" && c.text) return c.text;
    }
    return "";
  }
  /** 卡的显示编号:#effort/编号(根级无目录前缀);退化身份的 key 已带目录前缀,不重复拼。 */
  function numberText(row) {
    var key = String(row.key || "");
    if (key.includes("/")) return "#" + key;
    return "#" + (row.effortId ? row.effortId + "/" : "") + key;
  }
  /** 组内排序主键:编号尾数字(退化身份取文件名段里的数字,取不到按 0)。 */
  function numOf(row) {
    var m = /(\d+)\s*$/.exec(String(row.key || ""));
    return m ? parseInt(m[1], 10) : 0;
  }
  /** 三段排序(list-page.md):探索地图 → 规格 → 普通票;组内编号升序,标题/目录兜底。 */
  function sortRows(rows) {
    var rank = { map: 0, spec: 1 };
    return rows.slice().sort(function (a, b) {
      var ka = rank[a.type] ?? 2;
      var kb = rank[b.type] ?? 2;
      if (ka !== kb) return ka - kb;
      var d = numOf(a) - numOf(b);
      if (d) return d;
      d = String(a.title || "").localeCompare(String(b.title || ""));
      if (d) return d;
      return String(a.effortId || "").localeCompare(String(b.effortId || ""));
    });
  }
  /** 占用口径(与 computeCounts 同义):被 open 阻塞(断链按安全阻塞)。 */
  function isBlocked(row) {
    return Array.isArray(row.blockedBy) && row.blockedBy.some(function (r) {
      return !r || r.state !== "closed";
    });
  }
  function isClaimed(row) {
    return Array.isArray(row.assignees) && row.assignees.length > 0;
  }

  // ---- 状态视图 ----
  function renderLoading(doc, root) {
    var app = el(doc, "div", "ms-app");
    app.append(el(doc, "div", "ms-state ms-loading", COPY["panel.loading"]));
    root.replaceChildren(app);
  }
  function renderError(doc, root, err) {
    var app = el(doc, "div", "ms-app");
    var box = el(doc, "div", "ms-state ms-error");
    box.append(el(doc, "div", "ms-error-title", COPY["panel.loadFail"]));
    box.append(el(doc, "div", "ms-error-detail", (err && err.message) || String(err)));
    app.append(box);
    root.replaceChildren(app);
  }
  /** 空工作区引导态(延续骨架期文案,指向建卡技能,绝不回演示数据)。 */
  function renderGuide(doc, root) {
    var app = el(doc, "div", "ms-app");
    var box = el(doc, "div", "ms-state ms-empty");
    box.append(el(doc, "h1", "ms-empty-title", COPY["panel.empty.title"]));
    var p = el(doc, "p", "ms-empty-body");
    p.append(COPY["panel.empty.body0"]);
    p.append(el(doc, "code", null, COPY["panel.empty.setup"]));
    p.append(COPY["panel.empty.mid"]);
    p.append(el(doc, "code", null, COPY["panel.empty.tickets"]));
    p.append(COPY["panel.empty.end"]);
    box.append(p);
    box.append(el(doc, "p", "ms-empty-hint", COPY["panel.empty.hint"]));
    app.append(box);
    root.replaceChildren(app);
  }

  // ---- 计数胶囊条 + 卡片行 ----
  function renderCountsBar(doc, counts) {
    var bar = el(doc, "div", "ms-counts");
    for (var p of PILLS) {
      var pill = el(doc, "span", "ms-pill" + (p.color ? " ms-kpi" : ""), COPY[p.label] + " " + (counts[p.key] ?? 0));
      pill.setAttribute("data-key", p.key);
      if (p.color) {
        pill.setAttribute("data-color", p.color);
        pill.style.color = p.color;
        pill.style.borderColor = p.color;
      }
      bar.append(pill);
    }
    return bar;
  }
  /** open 阻塞者数(断链按安全阻塞计,与 isBlocked 同口径)。 */
  function openBlockerCount(row) {
    if (!Array.isArray(row.blockedBy)) return 0;
    return row.blockedBy.filter(function (r) {
      return !r || r.state !== "closed";
    }).length;
  }
  /** 容器子票统计:同工作单元的票行 → {total, closed}(container-view 三态的输入)。 */
  function containerStatsOf(rows) {
    var stats = {};
    for (var row of rows) {
      if (row.type !== "map" && row.type !== "spec") continue;
      var s = stats[row.effortId] || (stats[row.effortId] = { total: 0, closed: 0 });
      for (var t of rows) {
        if (t.effortId === row.effortId && t.type !== "map" && t.type !== "spec") {
          s.total++;
          if (t.state === "closed") s.closed++;
        }
      }
    }
    return stats;
  }

  /** 票行动作主色:档位 → colorOf 表 → 档位兜底色。 */
  function actionHexOf(row) {
    var action = Cards.rowActionKind ? Cards.rowActionKind(row) : "execute";
    var style = (Cards.CARD_ACTION_STYLE || {})[action] || {};
    return Cards.cardColorOf ? Cards.cardColorOf(style.colorKey, COLOR_OF, action) : "8b5cf6";
  }

  /** 编号徽章(PixelCardNo):实心档底=主色、字=cardInkOn、罩纱带挂标记;描线档边=主色。 */
  function appendBadge(doc, host, row, hex) {
    var style = (Cards.CARD_ACTION_STYLE || {})[Cards.rowActionKind ? Cards.rowActionKind(row) : ""] || {};
    var badge = el(doc, "span", "ms-num cd-no");
    badge.textContent = numberText(row);
    badge.setAttribute("title", numberText(row));
    if (style.hollow) {
      badge.className += " cd-nonum line";
      badge.style.borderColor = "#" + hex;
    } else {
      badge.style.background = "#" + hex;
      badge.style.color = Cards.cardInkOn ? Cards.cardInkOn(hex) : "#1c1004";
      if (Cards.cardBoostOn && Cards.cardBoostOn(hex)) badge.setAttribute("data-cd-boost", "1");
    }
    host.append(badge);
    return badge;
  }

  /** 容器角标:身份色 chip(地图/规格);票行状态角标:BUG 三角 / 在办 / 可接。 */
  function appendCornerMark(doc, host, row, occupied) {
    if (row.type === "map" || row.type === "spec") {
      var chip = el(doc, "span", "dsws-chip dsws-chip-container " + ((Cards.CONTAINER_CHIP_CLASS || {})[row.type] || ""));
      chip.textContent = (Cards.CONTAINER_CHIP_LABEL || {})[row.type] || "";
      chip.style.color = (Cards.CONTAINER_ACCENT || {})[row.type] || "";
      host.append(chip);
      return;
    }
    var hasBug = (row.labels || []).some(function (l) {
      return l && l.name === "bug";
    });
    if (row.state === "closed") {
      // closed 票无状态角标(bug 除外)
      if (hasBug) {
        var bugC = el(doc, "span", "cd-corner", COPY["card.bug"]);
        bugC.style.color = "#d73a4a"; // --cd-mark-bug
        host.append(bugC);
      }
      return;
    }
    if (occupied) {
      var doing = el(doc, "span", "cd-ckb", COPY["card.doing"]);
      doing.style.color = "#2b62b0"; // --cd-mark-doing
      host.append(doing);
      return;
    }
    if (hasBug) {
      var bug = el(doc, "span", "cd-corner", COPY["card.bug"]);
      bug.style.color = "#d73a4a"; // --cd-mark-bug
      host.append(bug);
      return;
    }
    var ready = el(doc, "span", "cd-ckj", COPY["card.pickReady"]);
    ready.style.color = "#10b981"; // --cd-mark-ready
    host.append(ready);
  }

  function renderRow(doc, row, ctx) {
    var closed = row.state === "closed";
    var occupied = !closed && (isClaimed(row) || isBlocked(row));
    var cls = "ms-row ms-kind-" + (row.type || "issue") + " " + (closed ? "ms-closed" : "ms-open");
    if (isClaimed(row)) cls += " ms-claimed";
    if (isBlocked(row)) cls += " ms-blocked";
    var r = el(doc, "div", cls);
    r.setAttribute("data-num", numberText(row));

    // 图钉(PixelCardPin):closed 票胶带,open 票圆图钉 #c0392b
    if (closed) {
      r.append(el(doc, "span", "cd-pin-tape"));
    } else {
      var pin = el(doc, "span", "cd-pin");
      pin.style.background = "#c0392b";
      r.append(pin);
    }

    var isContainer = row.type === "map" || row.type === "spec";
    var hex = isContainer
      ? ((Cards.containerNumberColor || function () { return "#8b5cf6"; })(
          row.type,
          (Cards.containerStateOf || function () { return "open"; })((ctx.containerStats || {})[row.effortId])
        )).slice(1)
      : actionHexOf(row);
    r.setAttribute("data-cd-act", "#" + hex);
    if (isContainer) {
      // 容器行身份色:左边框 accent + 底色 tint(container-view)
      r.style.borderLeft = "3px solid " + ((Cards.CONTAINER_ACCENT || {})[row.type] || "");
      r.style.background = (Cards.CONTAINER_TINT || {})[row.type] || "";
    }

    var head = el(doc, "div", "ms-row-head");
    appendCornerMark(doc, head, row, occupied);
    appendBadge(doc, head, row, hex);
    if (closed) {
      // 结案章(PixelClosedSeal):#a3231a 底 #fff9ec 字
      var seal = el(doc, "span", "cd-sealcn", COPY["card.closedSeal"]);
      seal.style.background = "#a3231a";
      seal.style.color = "#fff9ec";
      head.append(seal);
    }
    var title = el(doc, "span", "ms-title", row.title || "");
    title.setAttribute("title", row.title || "");
    head.append(title);
    head.append(el(doc, "span", "ms-state-chip", closed ? COPY["list.state.closed"] : COPY["card.openState"]));
    r.append(head);

    // 红色脚注(PixelCardNote):被 open 阻塞时「被 {n} 挡住」
    var blockers = openBlockerCount(row);
    if (blockers > 0 && !closed) {
      r.append(el(doc, "div", "cd-note", COPY["card.blockedBy"].replace("{n}", String(blockers))));
    }

    var foot = el(doc, "div", "ms-row-foot");
    var tags = el(doc, "div", "ms-tags");
    var labels = Array.isArray(row.labels) ? row.labels : [];
    for (var lab of labels) {
      if (!lab || !lab.name) continue;
      var lhex = labelColorOf(lab.name);
      var chip = el(doc, "span", "ms-label cd-lb");
      var dot = el(doc, "span", "ms-label-dot");
      dot.setAttribute("data-color", "#" + lhex);
      dot.style.background = "#" + lhex;
      chip.append(dot);
      chip.append(lab.name);
      // 标签墨块(PixelCardTags):真实标签色实心底 + cardInkOn 字色 + 罩纱标记;边 = darken(色,.16)
      chip.style.background = "#" + lhex;
      chip.style.color = Cards.cardInkOn ? Cards.cardInkOn(lhex) : "#1c1004";
      chip.style.borderColor = Cards.darkenHex ? Cards.darkenHex(lhex, 0.16) : "";
      if (Cards.cardBoostOn && Cards.cardBoostOn(lhex)) chip.setAttribute("data-cd-boost", "1");
      tags.append(chip);
    }
    foot.append(tags);
    var marks = el(doc, "div", "ms-marks");
    if (isClaimed(row)) marks.append(el(doc, "span", "ms-mark ms-mark-claimed", COPY["card.legendClaimed"]));
    if (isBlocked(row)) marks.append(el(doc, "span", "ms-mark ms-mark-blocked", COPY["list.blocked"]));
    foot.append(marks);
    r.append(foot);
    r.addEventListener("click", function () {
      openDetail(row);
    });
    return r;
  }
  // ---- 看板视图状态(工单 04):筛选/排序/标签点击记忆/关闭票折叠,内存态 ----
  var view = {
    state: "all", // all | open | closed | blocked | frontier(list-page.md 状态组)
    sortKey: "number", // updatedAt | createdAt | number | title;默认档「编号升序」
    sortDir: 1,
    labels: [], // 标签多选 OR
    clicks: {}, // 标签点击记忆 {name:{n,ts}}
    labelsOpen: false, // 标签组展开
    closedOpen: false, // 关闭票折叠区展开
  };
  var boardData = null; // 最近一次成功加载的 {rows, counts},筛选变化时原地重渲染

  function rerender(doc, root) {
    if (!boardData) return;
    renderBoard(doc, root, boardData.rows, boardData.counts, view);
  }

  /** 筛选行(listFilterRow.md:list-page.md §2):状态紫/排序蓝/标签真实色三组墨块。 */
  function renderFilterRow(doc, rows, view) {
    var bar = el(doc, "div", "ms-filter");
    var STATE_KEYS = [
      ["all", COPY["list.state.all"]], ["open", COPY["list.state.open"]], ["closed", COPY["list.state.closed"]],
      ["blocked", COPY["list.state.blocked"]], ["frontier", COPY["list.state.frontier"]],
    ];
    var SORT_KEYS = [
      ["updatedAt", COPY["list.sort.updatedAt"]], ["createdAt", COPY["list.sort.createdAt"]],
      ["number", COPY["list.sort.number"]], ["title", COPY["list.sort.title"]],
    ];
    var sep = function () {
      return el(doc, "i", "ms-filter-sep");
    };

    // 状态组(单选):选中墨块紫(rgba(188,140,255,.18)/.6 边,#c084fc 字 = CONTAINER_ACCENT.map)
    STATE_KEYS.forEach(function (pair, i) {
      var chip = el(doc, "span", "ms-chip ms-chip-state" + (view.state === pair[0] ? " is-on" : ""), pair[1]);
      chip.setAttribute("data-state", pair[0]);
      if (view.state === pair[0]) {
        chip.style.color = (Cards.CONTAINER_ACCENT || {}).map || "#c084fc";
        chip.style.background = "rgba(188,140,255,.18)";
        chip.style.borderColor = "rgba(188,140,255,.6)";
      }
      chip.addEventListener("click", function () {
        view.state = pair[0];
        rerender(doc, doc.getElementById("root"));
      });
      bar.append(chip);
      if (i === STATE_KEYS.length - 1) bar.append(sep());
    });

    // 排序组(单选+翻转):点同键翻转 asc/desc;换键时 title 默认 asc、其余 desc
    SORT_KEYS.forEach(function (pair, i) {
      var on = view.sortKey === pair[0];
      var chip = el(doc, "span", "ms-chip ms-chip-sort" + (on ? " is-on" : ""),
        pair[1] + (on ? (view.sortDir === 1 ? " ↑" : " ↓") : ""));
      chip.setAttribute("data-sort", pair[0]);
      if (on) {
        chip.style.color = "#58a6ff";
        chip.style.background = "rgba(88,166,255,.16)";
        chip.style.borderColor = "rgba(88,166,255,.55)";
      }
      chip.addEventListener("click", function () {
        if (view.sortKey === pair[0]) view.sortDir = -view.sortDir;
        else {
          view.sortKey = pair[0];
          view.sortDir = pair[0] === "title" ? 1 : -1;
        }
        rerender(doc, doc.getElementById("root"));
      });
      bar.append(chip);
      if (i === SORT_KEYS.length - 1) bar.append(sep());
    });

    // 标签组(多选 OR):全部恒清空;普通标签真实色;默认 4 颗,+N 展开/收起
    var allChip = el(doc, "span", "ms-chip ms-chip-label ms-chip-all" + (view.labels.length === 0 ? " is-on" : ""), COPY["list.all"]);
    allChip.setAttribute("data-label", "");
    if (view.labels.length === 0) {
      allChip.style.background = "rgba(255,255,255,.08)";
      allChip.style.borderColor = "rgba(255,255,255,.65)";
    }
    allChip.addEventListener("click", function () {
      view.labels = [];
      rerender(doc, doc.getElementById("root"));
    });
    bar.append(allChip);

    var catalog = Cards.labelCatalog ? Cards.labelCatalog(rows) : new Map();
    var sortedLabels = Cards.sortLabelChips ? Cards.sortLabelChips(catalog, view.clicks) : [];
    var shown = view.labelsOpen ? sortedLabels : sortedLabels.slice(0, 4);
    shown.forEach(function (item) {
      var hex = labelColorOf(item.name);
      var known = !!LABEL_COLORS[item.name];
      var on = view.labels.indexOf(item.name) >= 0;
      var chip = el(doc, "span", "ms-chip ms-chip-label" + (on ? " is-on" : ""), item.name);
      chip.setAttribute("data-label", item.name);
      chip.style.color = known ? "#" + hex : "#bc8cff";
      chip.style.background = Cards.hexA ? Cards.hexA(hex, 0.18) : "";
      chip.style.borderColor = Cards.darkenHex ? Cards.darkenHex(hex, 0.16) : "";
      chip.addEventListener("click", function () {
        var at = view.labels.indexOf(item.name);
        if (at >= 0) view.labels.splice(at, 1);
        else view.labels.push(item.name);
        var mem = view.clicks[item.name] || (view.clicks[item.name] = { n: 0, ts: 0 });
        mem.n += 1;
        mem.ts = Date.now();
        rerender(doc, doc.getElementById("root"));
      });
      bar.append(chip);
    });
    if (sortedLabels.length > 4) {
      var more = el(doc, "span", "ms-chip ms-chip-more", view.labelsOpen ? COPY["list.collapse"] : "+" + (sortedLabels.length - 4));
      more.addEventListener("click", function () {
        view.labelsOpen = !view.labelsOpen;
        rerender(doc, doc.getElementById("root"));
      });
      bar.append(more);
    }
    return bar;
  }

  function renderBoard(doc, root, rows, counts, view) {
    var app = el(doc, "div", "ms-app ms-board");
    var head = el(doc, "div", "ms-head");
    head.append(el(doc, "span", "ms-head-title", COPY["panel.boardTitle"]));
    app.append(head);
    app.append(renderCountsBar(doc, counts));
    app.append(renderFilterRow(doc, rows, view));

    var v = Cards.applyView ? Cards.applyView(rows, view) : { openRows: rows, closedRows: [] };
    var openRows = Cards.sortViewRows ? Cards.sortViewRows(v.openRows, view.sortKey, view.sortDir) : sortRows(v.openRows);
    var closedRows = Cards.sortViewRows ? Cards.sortViewRows(v.closedRows, view.sortKey, view.sortDir) : sortRows(v.closedRows);
    var visible = view.state === "closed" ? closedRows : openRows.concat(view.closedOpen ? closedRows : []);

    var list = el(doc, "div", "ms-rows");
    var ctx = { containerStats: containerStatsOf(rows) };
    for (var row of visible) list.append(renderRow(doc, row, ctx));
    app.append(list);
    if (visible.length === 0) app.append(el(doc, "div", "ms-none", COPY["list.none"]));
    if (view.state === "all" && closedRows.length > 0) {
      var fold = el(doc, "div", "ms-closed-fold" + (view.closedOpen ? " open" : ""),
        COPY["list.closedN"].replace("{n}", String(closedRows.length)));
      if (view.closedOpen) fold.append(el(doc, "span", "ms-fold-arrow", "▾"));
      else fold.append(el(doc, "span", "ms-fold-arrow", "▸"));
      fold.addEventListener("click", function () {
        view.closedOpen = !view.closedOpen;
        rerender(doc, root);
      });
      app.append(fold);
    }
    root.replaceChildren(app);
  }

  // ---- 视图状态(工单 05):进详情后列表数据留在缓存,返回时按工单 04 的 view 状态机
  // 原样重渲染(筛选/排序/折叠状态都保留)。详情态期间轮询照跑,新数据只进缓存
  // 不打扰画面;返回列表即用上新的一批。
  var st = { client: null, doc: null, root: null, rows: [], counts: {} };
  var inDetail = false;
  function openDetail(row) {
    if (!window.MattSkillsDetail) return;
    inDetail = true;
    window.MattSkillsDetail.open({
      client: st.client,
      doc: st.doc,
      root: st.root,
      row: row,
      onBack: function () {
        inDetail = false;
        renderBoard(st.doc, st.root, st.rows, st.counts, view);
      },
    });
  }

  // ---- 实时刷新(工单 08) ----
  // 可见时按 probeIntervalMs(5s,上游活跃探测口径)轮询 counts 的 revision,变化才重拉列表;
  // document 不可见即暂停(上游黄档 120s 依赖注意力信号,M1 无此信号,不引入)。
  var POLL_MS = 5000;
  var ctx = null; // 当前引导会话 {client, doc, root}
  var pollTimer = null;
  var lastRevision; // undefined = 未知(服务端没给 revision 就不自动刷新)
  var everLoaded = false; // 初始加载失败时轮询负责静默重试,成功过就只认 revision 信号
  var loading = false;
  var queued = false; // 载入途中又触发:结束后补一轮
  var visBound = false;

  /** 拉全套数据并渲染;silent 为真时不铺加载态、失败保留已渲染内容(轮询路径)。 */
  async function reload(opts) {
    var silent = opts && opts.silent;
    var c = ctx;
    if (!c) return;
    if (!silent) renderLoading(c.doc, c.root);
    if (loading) {
      queued = true;
      return;
    }
    loading = true;
    try {
      var results = await Promise.all([
        c.client.callTool("deck_issue_list", {}),
        c.client.callTool("deck_issue_counts", {}),
      ]);
      var list = results[0];
      var counts = results[1];
      if (list && list.isError) throw Error(textOf(list) || "deck_issue_list 失败");
      if (counts && counts.isError) throw Error(textOf(counts) || "deck_issue_counts 失败");
      var listSc = (list && list.structuredContent) || {};
      var countsSc = (counts && counts.structuredContent) || {};
      everLoaded = true;
      if (countsSc.revision !== undefined) lastRevision = countsSc.revision;
      if (countsSc.empty || listSc.empty) {
        renderGuide(c.doc, c.root);
        return;
      }
      // 缓存最新一批(空态不清缓存:详情里的返回还靠它,空态由列表视图的下一拍纠正)
      st.client = c.client;
      st.doc = c.doc;
      st.root = c.root;
      st.rows = Array.isArray(listSc.rows) ? listSc.rows : [];
      st.counts = countsSc.counts || {};
      boardData = { rows: st.rows, counts: st.counts }; // 工单 04:筛选态原地重渲染与详情返回共用这一批
      if (inDetail) return; // 详情态:数据只进缓存,不动画面(筛选/视图状态也原样保留)
      renderBoard(c.doc, c.root, st.rows, st.counts, view);
    } catch (e) {
      if (!silent) renderError(c.doc, c.root, e);
    } finally {
      loading = false;
      if (queued) {
        queued = false;
        reload({ silent: true });
      }
    }
  }

  /** 轮询一格:只打 counts,revision 变了才重拉列表。 */
  function tick() {
    var c = ctx;
    if (!c || loading) return;
    if (c.doc.hidden) return; // 不可见暂停,不空耗
    c.client
      .callTool("deck_issue_counts", {})
      .then(function (r) {
        if (!r || r.isError) return; // 失败静默,下轮再试
        var sc = (r && r.structuredContent) || {};
        if (lastRevision === undefined) {
          if (!everLoaded) reload({ silent: true }); // 初始加载失败过:轮询里静默重试
          return;
        }
        if (sc.revision !== undefined && sc.revision !== lastRevision) reload({ silent: true });
      })
      .catch(function () {});
  }

  // ---- 入口 ----
  async function boot(opts) {
    var client = opts.client;
    var doc = opts.doc;
    var root = opts.root;
    var pollMs = opts.pollMs === undefined ? POLL_MS : opts.pollMs;
    stopPolling(); // 重复引导(测试/宿主重挂)先撤旧节拍
    ctx = { client: client, doc: doc, root: root };
    lastRevision = undefined;
    everLoaded = false;
    if (!visBound && typeof doc.addEventListener === "function") {
      visBound = true;
      doc.addEventListener("visibilitychange", function () {
        if (!doc.hidden) tick(); // 转回可见立即补一格,不等下一拍
      });
    }
    if (pollMs > 0) pollTimer = setInterval(tick, pollMs);
    await reload({});
  }

  /** 强刷钩子:写操作/动作后立即重拉(revision 未变也拉;T06/T07 调)。 */
  function refresh() {
    return reload({ silent: true });
  }
  function stopPolling() {
    if (pollTimer) {
      clearInterval(pollTimer);
      pollTimer = null;
    }
  }

  window.MattSkillsPanel = { boot: boot, refresh: refresh, stopPolling: stopPolling };
})();

// MattSkills 详情视图(工单 05):列表行点击后的只读详情页;工单 07 起挂动作栏。
// 纯脚本无 import,与 app.js 由 build.mjs 拼进同一 bundle;app.js 在行点击时经
// window.MattSkillsDetail.open 调进来。结构对照上游 IssueDetail 的 M1 子集
// (port-notes/detail-page.md):粘性顶栏(返回+编号+标题,长文按阶梯折叠) → 头部(编号+标题)
// → 元行(状态/标签/认领/日期) → 动作栏(工单 07,档位按十级阶梯,经桥 ui/message 发话)
// → 正文(三态 + markdown 基础渲染) → 评论时间线 → 只读提示。
// 取数口径(#693):正文与评论一律以 deck_issue_get 那次取数为准;列表行只做轻量预览(元行)。
"use strict";
(function () {
  // ---- 文案(工单 09 收拢):单处集中在 copy.mjs(bundle 段序第一),本段只按键取值。 ----
  var COPY = globalThis.MattSkillsCopy;

  // 上游 IssueDetailComments 的显示切片页大小(detail-page.md §2):
  // 标题计数用全量,时间线一次只铺 50 条,超出给「显示其余」。
  var COMMENTS_PAGE_SIZE = 50;

  // 元数据字段行(可见写法,可加粗;围栏代码块内不算):这些进元行,不进描述。
  var FIELD_LINE_RE = /^(?:\*\*)?(?:status|labels?|label|type|blocked\s+by|assignees|close\s+reason)(?:\*\*)?\s*[:\uFF1A]/i;

  // ---- 小工具(与 app.js 各持一份:bundle 段落平级,不共享闭包) ----
  function el(doc, tag, cls, text) {
    var n = doc.createElement(tag);
    if (cls) n.className = cls;
    if (text !== undefined && text !== null) n.textContent = String(text);
    return n;
  }
  function textOf(res) {
    if (res && Array.isArray(res.content)) {
      for (var c of res.content) if (c && c.type === "text" && c.text) return c.text;
    }
    return "";
  }
  /** 卡的显示编号:#effort/编号;退化身份的 key 已带目录前缀,不重复拼。 */
  function numberText(row) {
    var key = String(row.key || "");
    if (key.includes("/")) return "#" + key;
    return "#" + (row.effortId ? row.effortId + "/" : "") + key;
  }
  /** get 寻址参数:退化身份原样;正常票补工作单元前缀,免得同号被目录序抢走。 */
  function getArgOf(row) {
    var key = String(row.key || "");
    if (key.includes("/")) return key;
    return row.effortId ? row.effortId + "/" + key : key;
  }
  function labelColorOf(name) {
    return LABEL_COLORS[name] || "cccccc";
  }
  // 内置默认标签色表,与 app.js 同源直拷(上游 defaultLabelPalette)。
  var LABEL_COLORS = {
    "bug": "d73a4a",
    "needs-triage": "fbca04",
    "needs-info": "5319e7",
    "ready-for-agent": "0e8a16",
    "ready-for-human": "b60205",
    "wontfix": "ffffff",
    "wayfinder:map": "8b5cf6",
    "wayfinder:research": "0ea5e9",
    "wayfinder:prototype": "f59e0b",
    "wayfinder:grilling": "9d7cd8",
    "wayfinder:task": "10b981",
  };

  // 像素卡/动作域(工单 04/07,bundle 里 cards.mjs 与 actions.mjs 在本段之前挂 globalThis)。
  var Cards = globalThis.MattSkillsCards || {};
  var Actions = globalThis.MattSkillsActions || {};
  // 页面 colorOf 表(与 app.js 同源直拷):标签配置色 + implement 档塞规格身份色。
  var COLOR_OF = Object.assign({}, LABEL_COLORS, { implement: "1D4ED8" });

  // ---- 描述抽取:整卡 markdown 里去掉标题/字段行/隐藏注释/Comments 段,剩下的才是「描述」 ----
  function descriptionOf(raw) {
    var s = String(raw || "");
    // 去 ## Comments 段(切分口径与 cards.mjs 的评论解析一致:段到下一个 H2 为止)
    var cm = /^\s*##\s*Comments\s*$/im.exec(s);
    if (cm) {
      var after = s.slice(cm.index + cm[0].length);
      var nextH2 = /^\s*##\s+/m.exec(after);
      s = s.slice(0, cm.index) + (nextH2 ? after.slice(nextH2.index) : "");
    }
    var out = [];
    var fenced = false;
    var h1Dropped = false;
    for (var line of s.split("\n")) {
      if (/^[ \t]*(```|~~~)/.test(line)) {
        fenced = !fenced;
        out.push(line);
        continue;
      }
      if (fenced) {
        out.push(line);
        continue;
      }
      var t = line.trim();
      if (/^<!--.*-->$/.test(t)) continue; // 文件头隐藏注释(DSH-*)整行去
      if (!h1Dropped && /^#{1,6}\s+/.test(t)) {
        h1Dropped = true; // 首个标题就是卡标题,头部已展示
        continue;
      }
      if (FIELD_LINE_RE.test(t)) continue; // 元数据字段行进元行
      out.push(line);
    }
    return out.join("\n").trim();
  }

  // ---- markdown 基础渲染(自写不引库):标题/列表/围栏代码块/粗斜体;全部走 DOM 构建,不吃 HTML ----
  var INLINE_RE = /\*\*(.+?)\*\*|\*(.+?)\*/g;
  function inlineNodes(doc, s) {
    var out = [];
    var last = 0;
    var m;
    INLINE_RE.lastIndex = 0;
    while ((m = INLINE_RE.exec(s))) {
      if (m.index > last) out.push(s.slice(last, m.index));
      if (m[1] !== undefined) out.push(el(doc, "strong", null, m[1]));
      else out.push(el(doc, "em", null, m[2]));
      last = m.index + m[0].length;
    }
    if (last < s.length) out.push(s.slice(last));
    return out;
  }
  function appendInline(doc, target, s) {
    target.append.apply(target, inlineNodes(doc, String(s || "")));
  }
  /** 块级:围栏代码块 → pre>code;#/##/… → h1..h6;- / * 连续行 → ul;N. 连续行 → ol;其余 → 段落。 */
  function mdNodes(doc, text) {
    var out = [];
    var lines = String(text || "").split("\n");
    var i = 0;
    while (i < lines.length) {
      var t = lines[i].trim();
      if (!t) {
        i++;
        continue;
      }
      if (/^(```|~~~)/.test(t)) {
        var buf = [];
        i++;
        while (i < lines.length && !/^[ \t]*(```|~~~)/.test(lines[i])) {
          buf.push(lines[i]);
          i++;
        }
        i++; // 收尾围栏
        var pre = el(doc, "pre", "ms-md-pre");
        pre.append(el(doc, "code", null, buf.join("\n")));
        out.push(pre);
        continue;
      }
      var h = /^(#{1,6})\s+(.*)$/.exec(t);
      if (h) {
        var hn = el(doc, "h" + h[1].length, "ms-md-h");
        appendInline(doc, hn, h[2]);
        out.push(hn);
        i++;
        continue;
      }
      var li;
      if (/^[-*]\s+/.test(t)) {
        var ul = el(doc, "ul", "ms-md-list");
        while (i < lines.length) {
          var um = /^[-*]\s+(.*)$/.exec(lines[i].trim());
          if (!um) break;
          li = el(doc, "li");
          appendInline(doc, li, um[1]);
          ul.append(li);
          i++;
        }
        out.push(ul);
        continue;
      }
      if (/^\d+[.]\s+/.test(t)) {
        var ol = el(doc, "ol", "ms-md-list");
        while (i < lines.length) {
          var om = /^\d+[.]\s+(.*)$/.exec(lines[i].trim());
          if (!om) break;
          li = el(doc, "li");
          appendInline(doc, li, om[1]);
          ol.append(li);
          i++;
        }
        out.push(ol);
        continue;
      }
      // 段落:连续普通行一段(soft-break 交给 CSS pre-wrap 保住)
      var buf2 = [];
      while (i < lines.length) {
        var pt = lines[i].trim();
        if (
          !pt || /^(```|~~~)/.test(pt) || /^#{1,6}\s+/.test(pt) ||
          /^[-*]\s+/.test(pt) || /^\d+[.]\s+/.test(pt)
        ) break;
        buf2.push(pt);
        i++;
      }
      out.push(el(doc, "p", "ms-md-p", buf2.join("\n")));
    }
    return out;
  }

  // ---- 顶栏折叠(issueDetailFold 口径,detail-page.md §3) ----
  // 阶梯:按元素顺序(上游五元素 back/crumb/snapshot/primary/newSession;M1 顶栏是
  // back/编号/标题三元素,同算法),每个元素按其字数逐级 push({el, n:1..len})。
  function foldLadderOf(elems) {
    var steps = [];
    for (var e of elems) {
      for (var n = 1; n <= e.text.length; n++) steps.push({ el: e.el, n: n });
    }
    return steps;
  }
  /** fits 判定:scrollWidth ≤ clientWidth+1;测量环境缺失(桩/离屏)视作放得下,不折。 */
  function foldFits(bar) {
    var sw = bar.scrollWidth;
    var cw = bar.clientWidth;
    if (typeof sw !== "number" || typeof cw !== "number") return true;
    return sw <= cw + 1;
  }
  /** 折叠机:先全量复位(data-full 兜底),不 fit 则 tier=1 逐档试;尾部逐字裁,不补省略号。 */
  function applyDetailFold(bar, elems) {
    if (!bar || !elems.length) return;
    for (var e of elems) {
      e.el.setAttribute("data-full", e.text);
      e.el.textContent = e.text;
    }
    if (foldFits(bar)) return;
    var steps = foldLadderOf(elems);
    for (var tier = 1; tier <= steps.length; tier++) {
      var drop = new Map();
      for (var k = 0; k < tier && k < steps.length; k++) drop.set(steps[k].el, steps[k].n);
      for (var e2 of elems) {
        var d = drop.get(e2.el) || 0;
        e2.el.textContent = e2.text.slice(0, e2.text.length - d);
      }
      void bar.offsetWidth; // 强制重排一次再量
      if (foldFits(bar)) return;
    }
  }
  var foldCtx = null; // 最近一次详情顶栏的折叠上下文
  var foldObserver = null;
  var foldBound = false;
  function refold() {
    if (foldCtx) applyDetailFold(foldCtx.bar, foldCtx.elems);
  }
  function bindFoldOnce() {
    if (foldBound) return;
    foldBound = true;
    if (typeof window.addEventListener === "function") window.addEventListener("resize", refold);
    if (typeof document !== "undefined" && document.fonts && document.fonts.ready && typeof document.fonts.ready.then === "function") {
      document.fonts.ready.then(refold);
    }
    if (typeof window.ResizeObserver === "function") foldObserver = new window.ResizeObserver(refold);
  }

  // ---- 详情状态与取数 ----
  var SEQ = 0;
  var cur = null; // {seq, client, doc, row, refs:{bodyBox,cmtTitle,cmtList,metaSlot}, lastCard, writerApi}

  function renderMeta(doc, row) {
    var meta = el(doc, "div", "ms-meta");
    meta.append(
      el(
        doc,
        "span",
        "ms-state-chip " + (row.state === "closed" ? "ms-chip-closed" : "ms-chip-open"),
        row.state === "closed" ? COPY["list.state.closed"] : COPY["card.openState"]
      )
    );
    var labels = Array.isArray(row.labels) ? row.labels : [];
    for (var lab of labels) {
      if (!lab || !lab.name) continue;
      var hex = "#" + labelColorOf(lab.name);
      var chip = el(doc, "span", "ms-label");
      var dot = el(doc, "span", "ms-label-dot");
      dot.setAttribute("data-color", hex);
      dot.style.background = hex;
      chip.append(dot);
      chip.append(lab.name);
      meta.append(chip);
    }
    var assignees = Array.isArray(row.assignees) ? row.assignees : [];
    for (var a of assignees) {
      if (a && a.login) meta.append(el(doc, "span", "ms-assignee", "@" + a.login));
      else meta.append(el(doc, "span", "ms-assignee", COPY["card.legendClaimed"])); // claimed 但没记名字
    }
    var updated = String(row.updatedAt || "").slice(0, 10);
    var created = String(row.createdAt || "").slice(0, 10);
    if (updated) meta.append(el(doc, "span", "ms-meta-date", COPY["detail.updated"].replace("{n}", updated)));
    if (created) meta.append(el(doc, "span", "ms-meta-date", COPY["detail.created"].replace("{n}", created)));
    return meta;
  }

  // ---- 动作栏(工单 07):十级阶梯档位 → 上游动作模板 → 经桥 ui/message 发进当前对话 ----
  var SVG_NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  /** 像素卡图标(PixelCardBtns 的 ICB 结构化直拷,viewBox 0 0 24 24,12×12,currentColor 随字色)。 */
  function iconSvg(doc, name) {
    var svg = doc.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "svg");
    svg.setAttribute("viewBox", "0 0 24 24");
    svg.setAttribute("width", "12");
    svg.setAttribute("height", "12");
    svg.setAttribute("class", "ms-abtn-ic");
    var parts = (Actions.ACTION_ICONS || {})[name] || [];
    for (var p of parts) {
      var n = doc.createElementNS(SVG_NS, p.tag);
      for (var k in p.attrs) n.setAttribute(k, p.attrs[k]);
      svg.append(n);
    }
    return svg;
  }

  /** 动作栏装槽:容器行/动作域缺席不画;初始与写后重拉共用这一出口整块换新(T09 缝)。 */
  function appendActionBar(slot, doc, row, seq) {
    var bar = renderActionBar(doc, row, seq);
    if (bar) slot.replaceChildren(bar);
    else slot.replaceChildren();
  }

  /**
   * 详情动作栏:一颗主动作按钮(档位 = rowActionKind,样式/图标按 CARD_ACTION_STYLE,
   * 实心底=主色字=cardInkOn / 描线边=主色墨字)+ 状态位。容器行不画(容器三态动作条不在本票)。
   * 门控 detailTopGateOf:关闭/被明确 open 的票阻塞 → 置灰不可发(未知状态不置灰)。
   */
  function renderActionBar(doc, row, seq) {
    if (row.type === "map" || row.type === "spec") return null;
    if (!Actions.buildActionPrompt || !Cards.rowActionKind) return null; // 动作域缺席(bundle 异常)不画,不拦详情
    var kind = Cards.rowActionKind(row);
    var style = (Cards.CARD_ACTION_STYLE || {})[kind] || {};
    var hex = Cards.cardColorOf ? Cards.cardColorOf(style.colorKey, COLOR_OF, kind) : "8b5cf6";

    var bar = el(doc, "div", "ms-actionbar");
    var btn = el(doc, "button", "ms-abtn" + (style.hollow ? " hollow" : ""));
    btn.setAttribute("type", "button");
    btn.setAttribute("data-kind", kind);
    btn.setAttribute("data-icon", style.icon || "play");
    btn.append(iconSvg(doc, style.icon));
    btn.append(el(doc, "span", "ms-abtn-lbl", (Actions.ACTION_LABELS || {})[kind] || kind));
    if (style.hollow) {
      btn.style.borderColor = "#" + hex; // 描线档:边=主色,透明底,墨字
    } else {
      btn.style.background = "#" + hex; // 实心档:底=主色,字=cardInkOn
      btn.style.color = Cards.cardInkOn ? Cards.cardInkOn(hex) : "#1c1004";
      if (Cards.cardBoostOn && Cards.cardBoostOn(hex)) btn.setAttribute("data-cd-boost", "1");
    }
    var status = el(doc, "span", "ms-act-status");
    bar.append(btn, status);

    var gate = Actions.detailTopGateOf ? Actions.detailTopGateOf(row)
      : { clickable: true, reason: "none", blockedNumbers: [] };
    if (!gate.clickable) {
      // 上游 #1668/#1669:置灰 = aria-disabled + tabIndex -1 + 悬停说原因,点击无动作
      btn.setAttribute("aria-disabled", "true");
      btn.setAttribute("tabindex", "-1");
      btn.setAttribute("title", gate.reason === "closed" ? COPY["tip.detailClosedReadonly"]
        : COPY["tip.detailBlockedBy"].replace("{n}", gate.blockedNumbers.map(function (n) { return "#" + n; }).join("、")));
    }

    var sending = false;
    btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
      if (!gate.clickable || sending) return;
      sending = true;
      btn.setAttribute("disabled", "1");
      status.className = "ms-act-status";
      status.textContent = COPY["act.sending"];
      // {url} 的 M1 值:上游取票链接,本地卡是文件;一行带齐卡号/标题/路径(工单验收的上下文占位)
      var ref = numberText(row) + " " + String(row.title || "");
      if (row.url) ref += "（" + row.url + "）";
      var prompt = Actions.buildActionPrompt(kind, { url: ref });
      cur.client.sendMessage(prompt).then(
        function () {
          if (!cur || cur.seq !== seq) return; // 已返回列表/已换卡:迟到应答丢弃
          sending = false;
          btn.removeAttribute("disabled");
          status.textContent = COPY["act.sent"];
        },
        function (err) {
          if (!cur || cur.seq !== seq) return;
          sending = false;
          btn.removeAttribute("disabled");
          status.className = "ms-act-status is-err";
          status.textContent = COPY["act.fail"] + ((err && err.message) || String(err));
        }
      );
    });
    return bar;
  }

  function commentItem(doc, c) {
    var it = el(doc, "div", "ms-cmt-item");
    var head = el(doc, "div", "ms-cmt-head");
    head.append(el(doc, "span", "ms-cmt-login", "@" + ((c && c.author && c.author.login) || "ghost")));
    var date = String((c && c.createdAt) || "").slice(0, 10);
    if (date) head.append(el(doc, "span", "ms-cmt-date", date));
    it.append(head);
    var body = el(doc, "div", "ms-cmt-body");
    var nodes = mdNodes(doc, (c && c.body) || "");
    body.append.apply(body, nodes);
    it.append(body);
    return it;
  }

  function renderCard(card) {
    var refs = cur.refs;
    var doc = cur.doc;
    // 正文三态之三:取到了才有资格说「无描述」
    var desc = descriptionOf(card.body);
    if (desc) {
      var nodes = mdNodes(doc, desc);
      refs.bodyBox.replaceChildren.apply(refs.bodyBox, nodes);
    } else {
      refs.bodyBox.replaceChildren(el(doc, "div", "ms-body-empty", COPY["detail.noBody"]));
    }
    // 评论时间线:计数以详情为准;未取到前不许报「评论 (0)」
    var comments = Array.isArray(card.comments) ? card.comments : [];
    refs.cmtTitle.textContent = COPY["detail.commentsCount"].replace("{n}", String(comments.length));
    refs.cmtList.replaceChildren();
    var shown = Math.min(comments.length, COMMENTS_PAGE_SIZE);
    for (var i = 0; i < shown; i++) refs.cmtList.append(commentItem(doc, comments[i]));
    if (comments.length > shown) {
      var more = el(doc, "button", "ms-cmt-more");
      more.setAttribute("type", "button");
      var update = function () {
        more.textContent = COPY["detail.commentsMore"].replace("{n}", String(comments.length - shown));
      };
      update();
      more.addEventListener("click", function () {
        var next = Math.min(comments.length, shown + COMMENTS_PAGE_SIZE);
        for (var j = shown; j < next; j++) refs.cmtList.append(commentItem(doc, comments[j]));
        shown = next;
        if (shown >= comments.length) more.remove();
        else update();
      });
      refs.cmtList.append(more);
    }
  }

  function renderFail(seq, msg) {
    var refs = cur.refs;
    var doc = cur.doc;
    var box = el(doc, "div", "ms-body-error");
    box.append(el(doc, "div", "ms-body-error-title", COPY["detail.loadFail"]));
    box.append(el(doc, "div", "ms-error-detail", msg || ""));
    var retry = el(doc, "button", "ms-retry", COPY["detail.retry"]);
    retry.setAttribute("type", "button");
    retry.addEventListener("click", function () {
      if (!cur || cur.seq !== seq) return;
      var s2 = ++SEQ;
      cur.seq = s2;
      refs.bodyBox.replaceChildren(el(doc, "div", "ms-body-loading", COPY["list.loading"]));
      refs.cmtTitle.textContent = COPY["detail.commentsLoading"];
      refs.cmtList.replaceChildren();
      fetchDetail(s2);
    });
    box.append(retry);
    refs.bodyBox.replaceChildren(box);
    refs.cmtTitle.textContent = COPY["detail.notYet"];
    refs.cmtList.replaceChildren();
  }

  /** rebuildBar 为真(写后重拉路径)时,动作栏档位/置灰按新卡整块重建;首开/重试不动初始栏。 */
  function fetchDetail(seq, rebuildBar) {
    cur.client.callTool("deck_issue_get", { key: getArgOf(cur.row) }).then(
      function (res) {
        if (!cur || cur.seq !== seq) return; // 已返回列表/已重试:迟到应答丢弃
        if (res && res.isError) return renderFail(seq, textOf(res));
        var card = res && res.structuredContent && res.structuredContent.card;
        if (!card || typeof card.body !== "string") return renderFail(seq, COPY["detail.badShape"]);
        renderCard(card);
        cur.lastCard = card;
        // 工单 06:写后重拉到这里,元行与写入口按钮跟着新卡翻新
        if (cur.refs.metaSlot) cur.refs.metaSlot.replaceChildren(renderMeta(cur.doc, card));
        // 工单 09 缝:写后重拉时动作栏档位/置灰按新卡重建(详情里关闭卡 → 置灰;重开 → 恢复)
        if (rebuildBar && cur.refs.actionSlot) appendActionBar(cur.refs.actionSlot, cur.doc, card, seq);
        if (cur.writerApi) cur.writerApi.render();
      },
      function (err) {
        if (!cur || cur.seq !== seq) return;
        renderFail(seq, (err && err.message) || String(err));
      }
    );
  }

  /** 写成功后的重拉(工单 06):作废在途应答,重走 fetchDetail;T09 起动作栏门禁随新卡重建。 */
  function refetchDetail() {
    if (!cur) return; // 已返回列表:迟到写应答不再动画面
    var seq = ++SEQ;
    cur.seq = seq;
    fetchDetail(seq, true);
  }

  /** 入口:app.js 行点击调进来。shell 即刻渲染(元行用列表行轻量预览),正文/评论等 get 回来。 */
  function open(opts) {
    var client = opts.client;
    var doc = opts.doc;
    var row = opts.row;
    var seq = ++SEQ;
    cur = { seq: seq, client: client, doc: doc, row: row, refs: null };
    var num = numberText(row);
    var title = String(row.title || "");

    var app = el(doc, "div", "ms-app ms-detail");
    // 粘性顶栏:返回 + 编号 + 标题(折叠阶梯的三元素,各自留 data-full 底稿)
    var bar = el(doc, "div", "ms-topbar");
    bar.setAttribute("data-detail-topbar", "1");
    var back = el(doc, "button", "ms-back", COPY["list.back"]);
    back.setAttribute("type", "button");
    back.setAttribute("data-full", COPY["list.back"]);
    var bnum = el(doc, "span", "ms-topbar-num", num);
    bnum.setAttribute("data-full", num);
    bnum.setAttribute("title", num);
    var btitle = el(doc, "span", "ms-topbar-title", title);
    btitle.setAttribute("data-full", title);
    btitle.setAttribute("title", title);
    bar.append(back, bnum, btitle);
    app.append(bar);
    // 头部:编号徽标 + 标题(全文)
    var head = el(doc, "div", "ms-detail-head");
    var hnum = el(doc, "span", "ms-num", num);
    hnum.setAttribute("title", num);
    var htitle = el(doc, "span", "ms-detail-title", title);
    htitle.setAttribute("title", title);
    head.append(hnum, htitle);
    app.append(head);
    // 元行装进槽位:写后重拉新卡时可整块换新(工单 06)
    var metaSlot = el(doc, "div", "ms-meta-slot");
    metaSlot.append(renderMeta(doc, row));
    app.append(metaSlot);
    // 动作栏(工单 07):元行之下、正文之上;装进槽位,写后重拉按新卡换新(T09 缝)
    var actionSlot = el(doc, "div", "ms-actionbar-slot");
    appendActionBar(actionSlot, doc, row, seq);
    app.append(actionSlot);
    // 正文块(三态容器)
    var sec = el(doc, "div", "ms-body-sec");
    sec.append(el(doc, "div", "ms-sec-title", COPY["detail.descTitle"]));
    var bodyBox = el(doc, "div", "ms-body");
    bodyBox.append(el(doc, "div", "ms-body-loading", COPY["list.loading"]));
    sec.append(bodyBox);
    app.append(sec);
    // 评论时间线
    var cmt = el(doc, "div", "ms-comments");
    var cmtTitle = el(doc, "div", "ms-comments-title", COPY["detail.commentsLoading"]);
    var cmtList = el(doc, "div", "ms-cmt-list");
    cmt.append(cmtTitle, cmtList);
    app.append(cmt);
    // 工单 06:写入口(评论输入框 + 关闭/重开按钮),实现在 writer.mjs 独立段
    var writerHost = el(doc, "div", "ms-writer");
    app.append(writerHost);
    // 底部写回纪律提示
    app.append(el(doc, "div", "ms-writenote", COPY["detail.writeNote"]));
    opts.root.replaceChildren(app);
    cur.refs = { bodyBox: bodyBox, cmtTitle: cmtTitle, cmtList: cmtList, metaSlot: metaSlot, actionSlot: actionSlot };
    cur.writerApi =
      window.MattSkillsWriter && typeof window.MattSkillsWriter.mount === "function"
        ? window.MattSkillsWriter.mount({
            doc: doc,
            host: writerHost,
            client: client,
            getKey: function () {
              return getArgOf((cur && cur.row) || row);
            },
            getCard: function () {
              return (cur && cur.lastCard) || row;
            },
            onWritten: refetchDetail,
          })
        : null;

    // 折叠:本顶栏挂进上下文,resize/fonts/RO 重算
    bindFoldOnce();
    if (foldObserver) {
      foldObserver.disconnect();
      foldObserver.observe(bar);
    }
    foldCtx = {
      bar: bar,
      elems: [
        { el: back, text: COPY["list.back"] },
        { el: bnum, text: num },
        { el: btitle, text: title },
      ],
    };
    applyDetailFold(bar, foldCtx.elems);

    back.addEventListener("click", function () {
      close();
      if (typeof opts.onBack === "function") opts.onBack();
    });

    fetchDetail(seq);
  }

  function close() {
    SEQ++; // 迟到应答作废
    cur = null;
    foldCtx = null;
    if (foldObserver) foldObserver.disconnect();
  }

  window.MattSkillsDetail = { open: open };
})();

// MattSkills 详情写入口(工单 06):评论输入框 + 状态按钮(最小集:关闭/重开)。
// 纯脚本无 import,与 app.js/detail.mjs 由 build.mjs 拼进同一 bundle;detail.open 经
// window.MattSkillsWriter.mount 挂进来(独立段,方便与其他详情增强并行)。
// 全部写经桥调 MCP 写工具(deck_issue_comment/close/reopen),key 用 get 同口径的
// 目录前缀寻址;成功后调 window.MattSkillsPanel.refresh()(T08 强刷钩子)并回调
// onWritten() 让详情重拉;失败把服务端人话错误原样上屏,输入不丢。
"use strict";
(function () {
  // ---- 文案(工单 09 收拢):单处集中在 copy.mjs(bundle 段序第一),本段只按键取值。 ----
  var COPY = globalThis.MattSkillsCopy;

  function el(doc, tag, cls, text) {
    var n = doc.createElement(tag);
    if (cls) n.className = cls;
    if (text !== undefined && text !== null) n.textContent = String(text);
    return n;
  }
  function textOf(res) {
    if (res && Array.isArray(res.content)) {
      for (var c of res.content) if (c && c.type === "text" && c.text) return c.text;
    }
    return "";
  }

  /**
   * 挂载写入口。
   * opts = { doc, host, client, getKey()→string, getCard()→card, onWritten() }
   * 返回 { render }:详情重拿到新卡后调 render(),按钮随状态翻转;输入框内容跨 render 保留。
   */
  function mount(opts) {
    var doc = opts.doc;
    var host = opts.host;
    var client = opts.client;
    var busy = false;
    var draft = ""; // 输入框草稿:写失败/重渲染不丢
    var hint = el(doc, "div", "ms-write-hint");
    var body = el(doc, "div", "ms-writer-body");
    host.append(hint, body);
    var ta = null;

    function show(text, kind) {
      hint.textContent = String(text || "");
      hint.className = "ms-write-hint" + (kind ? " is-" + kind : "");
    }

    function call(tool, args) {
      if (busy) return;
      busy = true;
      show(COPY["writer.sending"], "");
      client.callTool(tool, args).then(
        function (res) {
          busy = false;
          if (res && res.isError) return show(textOf(res) || "写入失败", "err");
          show(COPY["writer.done"], "ok");
          draft = ""; // 成功才清草稿;输入框即刻清空(不等重渲染——render 会从 value 回收草稿)
          if (ta) ta.value = "";
          if (typeof window.MattSkillsPanel === "object" && window.MattSkillsPanel && typeof window.MattSkillsPanel.refresh === "function") {
            window.MattSkillsPanel.refresh(); // 强刷钩子:列表缓存立即跟上(revision 已由写路径推进)
          }
          if (typeof opts.onWritten === "function") opts.onWritten(); // 详情重拉:时间线/元行/按钮翻新
        },
        function (err) {
          busy = false;
          show((err && err.message) || String(err), "err");
        }
      );
    }

    function doComment() {
      var text = String((ta && ta.value) || "").trim();
      if (!text) return show(COPY["writer.emptyBody"], "err");
      draft = text;
      call("deck_issue_comment", { key: opts.getKey(), body: text });
    }

    function doState(card) {
      var closed = card.state === "closed";
      call(closed ? "deck_issue_reopen" : "deck_issue_close", { key: opts.getKey() });
    }

    function render() {
      var card = opts.getCard();
      if (ta) draft = String(ta.value || ""); // 重渲染前收草稿
      body.replaceChildren();
      ta = null;
      if (!card || card.type === "map" || card.type === "spec") return; // 容器(规格/地图)不给写
      var closed = card.state === "closed";
      var row = el(doc, "div", "ms-cmd-row");
      var btn = el(doc, "button", "ms-cmd-btn" + (closed ? "" : " ms-cmd-close"), closed ? COPY["writer.reopen"] : COPY["writer.close"]);
      btn.setAttribute("type", "button");
      btn.setAttribute("data-act", closed ? "reopen" : "close");
      btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
        doState(opts.getCard());
      });
      row.append(btn);
      body.append(row);

      var box = el(doc, "div", "ms-composer");
      ta = el(doc, "textarea", "ms-cmt-input");
      ta.setAttribute("placeholder", COPY["detail.cmtPlaceholder"]);
      ta.setAttribute("rows", "2");
      if (draft) ta.value = draft;
      var send = el(doc, "button", "ms-cmt-send", COPY["tip.sendComment"]);
      send.setAttribute("type", "button");
      send.addEventListener("click", doComment);
      box.append(ta, send);
      body.append(box);
    }

    render();
    return { render: render };
  }

  window.MattSkillsWriter = { mount: mount };
})();
